query:
SELECT
             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dt.value->>'migrations_enabled' = 'true')::BIGINT AS "enabled!",
             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dt.value->>'migrations_enabled' = 'false')::BIGINT AS "disabled!",
             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dt.value->>'migrations_enabled' IS NULL)::BIGINT AS "unset!"
           FROM workspace_settings ws,
                LATERAL jsonb_each(ws.datatable->'datatables') dt
           WHERE jsonb_typeof(ws.datatable->'datatables') = 'object'
